entries.title: Ticking the plain HTTP approval for a custom API works on the first click
entries.body: When you typed a custom API connection's address, or approved one from a connection file, the line saying where Infinitary sends appeared a moment later and pushed the plain HTTP approval down. A click made just then could miss and leave the box unticked. That line's place is now kept while Infinitary looks up the address, so nothing under it moves.
entries.noPicture: Once the line appears the form looks as it did before; the fix removes a jump a still picture cannot show.
